theme.name: Swiss Brutalist Utility
theme.description: An authoritative, function-first interface built for dense data manipulation and clear operational signaling. It relies purely on high-contrast colors, strict CSS grids, and generous negative space rather than decorative elements. Everything is custom CSS with CSS properties.
core_principles: No Component Libraries: Absolutely no Tailwind, no Bootstrap, no Shadcn. Use vanilla CSS and CSS variables only.
Density with Breathability: Use tight padding inside data cells but wide margins between macro sections.
Semantic Color Only: Color is reserved exclusively for primary actions (Blue) and SLA status/alerts (Red/Yellow/Green). Grayscale for everything else.
Optical Alignment: Ensure badges, icons, and text are optically centered in raw CSS.

rules.h1: font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: var(--text-3xl); font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1;
rules.h2: font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: var(--text-2xl); font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.2;
rules.body: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-text-main);
rules.labels: font-size: var(--text-xs); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-weight: medium; color: var(--color-text-muted);

components.instructions: NO TAILWIND OR SHADCN. Create a global 'variables.css' and 'reset.css'. For components, use plain scoped '.css' or CSS modules.

buttons.primary: bg: var(--brand-primary); color: white; radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); border: none; font-weight: 500;
buttons.secondary: bg: transparent; color: var(--text-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-heavy); radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
buttons.hover_state: Transform: translateY(-1px); Box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); Transition: all 0.2s ease.

cards.base: bg: var(--background-surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-light); radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-6);
cards.kanban_column: bg: var(--background-main); border: none; radius: var(--radius-md); padding: var(--space-4); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3);

badges.base: padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2); border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600;

inputs.base: border: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); radius: var(--radius-sm); width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-body);

tables.header: border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-heavy); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--text-sm); padding: var(--space-3);
tables.cell: border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); vertical-align: middle;

layout.app_shell: CSS Grid layout. 250px sidebar (fixed), 1fr main content area. Header height 64px.
layout.dashboard_grid: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-6);
layout.chat_room: display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: calc(100vh - 64px). Messages area: flex-grow: 1; overflow-y: auto. Input area: sticky bottom, border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light).

motion.bell_ring: Use CSS keyframes for a slight rotation (shake) when a new WebSocket message arrives.

accessibility.focus_rings: Mandatory. Do not use 'outline: none' without a fallback focus indicator. Use --border-focus color.
accessibility.contrast: SLA colors must meet WCAG 4.5:1 on their backgrounds. Avoid placing white text directly on Warning Yellow.
accessibility.test_ids: ALL interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="login-submit-button"').

login_cover.description: Minimalist concrete architecture. Use as the hero/cover image on the left/right split screen of the Login and Register pages.

brand_logo.description: Four white squares grid on mint background. Use as the company logo in the sidebar and auth pages.

avatar_female.description: Professional headshot portrait. Use as a placeholder avatar for female technician/user profiles.

avatar_male.description: Professional headshot portrait. Use as a placeholder avatar for male admin/technician profiles.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Tailwind CSS. Do NOT install Shadcn UI, Radix, MUI, or Bootstrap.
Use plain CSS variables mapped to standard CSS files (`reset.css`, `variables.css`, `layout.css`, `components.css`).
Structure the UI via vanilla React (JSX/TSX), standard CSS Grid/Flexbox, and React Router.
Implement WebSocket real-time updates natively or with 'socket.io-client'.
Enforce `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, and clickable cards.
